# Template — Content Republication Agreement (short form)

> ⚠️ **Template only — professional review recommended.** For republishing
> third-party content (e.g. BAMB depot price bulletins, ministry notices,
> extension material) on the AgriSphere platform under the platform rule
> "official bulletins only, always attributed, never altered". Fill every
> `[bracket]`.

**Title:** `[e.g. Republication of BAMB depot price bulletins]`
**Date:** `[date]`

## Parties
1. **Content owner:** `[organisation, e.g. Botswana Agricultural Marketing
   Board, address, contact]` ("Owner")
2. **Publisher:** `[AgriSphere operator legal entity, address, contact]`
   ("Publisher")

## 1. Grant
The Owner grants the Publisher a non-exclusive, revocable, **free** licence
to reproduce the following content on the Publisher's platform and in its
chat/alert outputs, for the benefit of farmers:

- Content: `[e.g. weekly depot price bulletins for grains — figures, dates,
  depot names]`
- Form: `[e.g. as published by the Owner; summary tables derived from them]`
- Territory & term: `[Botswana / worldwide]` for `[12 months / until
  revoked with · days' notice]`

## 2. Attribution & integrity
1. Every republication carries: source ("`[BAMB]`"), the content's date,
  and a link to the Owner's original publication `[URL pattern]`.
2. Figures are reproduced **without alteration**. Any reformatting must not
  change values, order or meaning.
3. The Publisher will not present the content as its own and will correct
  any error of attribution promptly on notice.

## 3. Use & boundaries
1. The content is shown **free of charge** to end users; the Publisher may
  not sell the content itself or bundle it into paid products without the
  Owner's written consent.
2. The Publisher will not use the content to disparage the Owner or in any
  way that implies the Owner endorses the Publisher's products (the
  Publisher's honesty rules already prohibit such claims; this clause
  restates it contractually).
3. The Owner may publish the same content anywhere, including with other
  publishers (no exclusivity).

## 4. Termination & takedown
1. Either party may end the licence with `[·]` days' written notice.
2. On notice of any dispute about accuracy, the Publisher will take the
  affected items down within `[48 hours]` while the parties resolve it.

## 5. No warranty & liability
1. The Owner provides the content "as published" and is not liable for
  losses from decisions taken on it (the Publisher's platform already tells
  users prices are references to verify).
2. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss under this
  short-form licence.

## 6. Law
`[Botswana / ·]` law; courts of `[·]`.

**Owner:** name/role/signature/date

**Annex:** sample bulletin + display mock (optional).
